class Cache
  def initialize(packer: nil)
    @packer = packer
    @store = {}
  end

  def write(key, payload, stale: false)
    if @packer
      stored_payload = @packer.dump(payload)
    else
      stored_payload = payload
    end
    @store[key] = [stored_payload, stale]
  end

    entry = @store[key]
    return nil if entry.nil?

    stored_payload, stale = entry
    if stale

      nil
    else

        @packer.load(stored_payload)
      else
        stored_payload

    end
  end

      stale
    end.keys
    keys_to_remove.each do |key|

    end

  def initialize(from)

  end

  def each
    if block_given?
      from = @from

        yield from
        from -= 1
      end
      self
